design.colour: preset 0-4 with probability 0.8, else custom index 5 with random RGB; usealpha 0 with probability 0.25; alpha 255 with probability 0.4, else uniform 0-255
design.flags: every group at every scope with the four dot/T combinations
design.split: development: hash(crosscheck-v1:size/thickness/gap)%10: 0-1 validation, 2-9 train. Fresh test and edge challenge are separate draws with their own seeds, generated and hashed before any fitting.

freeze.rule: The trainer refuses to run when these hashes differ from the committed artifact; npm run emulator:crosscheck -- --refreeze records a deliberate change of the feature code or capacity lists.

provenance.speedGate: not-a-substitute: the converter still exports the solver result
provenance.labels: infer() with community-static-2026-10 (community-static-v6), read back through nativeCommands. All design inputs are SYNTHETIC; corpus and presets are published settings labelled by the same solver, not native captures.
provenance.inference: lib/solver/ml-crosscheck.js: source arithmetic for the old shape and the regime transforms, a bracketing candidate set of its own, learned ranker and heads. It never calls solveCommunity, searchCommunity, communityAxis or the edge-case planner (checked by tests/tooling/boundaries.test.mjs).
provenance.selection: Capacities from fixed lists, chosen on validation only (ranker: core exact; each head group: its key exact); refit on train+validation.
provenance.freshEvaluation: Fresh test (new seed) and edge challenge drawn and hashed (freshInputsSha256) before the first fit. They are scored only after the final refit and never select a feature or capacity. On 2026-10-02 they were scored, one comparator reporting bug (exportV1 scored on keys it does not predict) was fixed, and they were rescored; the repository cannot prove that no other run happened in between. Reruns reproduce the final run byte for byte.
provenance.regression: evaluations.regression re-scores earlier splits whose labels were already seen (accuracy, structured and export v1 test and challenge splits, corpus, presets). They are regression numbers, not fresh evidence.
provenance.scope: Agreement with our own converter on designed inputs, never game accuracy. Group intervals are cluster-resampling stability intervals.
